HEXCHRON.ToolAlign: Align Grid (drag the red dot to move, the blue dot to resize)
HEXCHRON.ResetFogConfirm: This clears every hex's explored state for this scene - terrain and structures go back to unknown for every player. This cannot be undone. Continue?
HEXCHRON.ResetFogSuccess: Fog of war reset for this scene.
HEXCHRON.DirectoryEmpty: No hexes authored on this scene yet.
HEXCHRON.EditorHint: Fields left blank are simply ignored, matching the original hex-chronicle tool.
HEXCHRON.FieldMixedTerrainHint: One override per line: "type: side1 side2" (sides: N, NE, SE, S, SW, NW, C).
HEXCHRON.TerrainDiagramHint: Pick a terrain below, then click zones on the hex to paint them. Click a painted zone again to clear it.
HEXCHRON.PathDiagramHint: Click two points on the hex to draw a path between them. Click an existing path to remove it.
HEXCHRON.FieldStructureRevealedHint: Independent from terrain exploration: players can know this hex's terrain without knowing about its building icon/label/link yet.
HEXCHRON.FieldLinkHint: Drag a Journal Entry, a Journal page, or a Scene from the sidebar onto the field, or paste a UUID by hand. The "Open Link" canvas tool (and this field's button) opens it.
HEXCHRON.NoLink: This hex has no linked Journal Entry or Scene.
HEXCHRON.LinkNotFound: Couldn't resolve link "{uuid}" - the document may have been deleted.
HEXCHRON.LinkUnsupported: "{uuid}" isn't a Journal Entry, Journal page, or Scene.
HEXCHRON.ImportHint: Select one or more .md (hex-chronicle frontmatter) or .yaml/.yml files to import into this scene.
HEXCHRON.SettingHexRadiusHint: Distance from a hex's center to its east/west vertex.
HEXCHRON.SettingAutoRevealHint: When enabled, a player token entering a hex reveals it automatically (GM client must be connected).
HEXCHRON.SettingAutoRevealRadiusHint: 0 reveals only the hex the token enters; higher values also reveal that many rings of neighbors.
HEXCHRON.SettingPaletteHint: Optional JSON like {"terrain":{"plains":"#90ee90"},"zone":{"dangerous":"#ff0000"}} to override default colors.
